kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أغترف (form VIII)
# أَغْتَرِفُ (ʔaḡtarifu) /ʔaɣ.ta.ri.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# أُغْتَرَفُ (ʔuḡtarafu) /ʔuɣ.ta.ra.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# أَغْتَرِفَ (ʔaḡtarifa) /ʔaɣ.ta.ri.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# أُغْتَرَفَ (ʔuḡtarafa) /ʔuɣ.ta.ra
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
